risks.text: turbo `build` and `test` depend on ^build, and apps/web builds need prisma:generate first; running web commands without building packages/ui and packages/utils uses stale or missing dist - turbo.json:6

rules.rule: Delete R2 objects for a link only with keys from getOwnedLinkImageKey(image, linkId), and never delete the image the link now uses.
rules.why: Otherwise an update or delete can wipe another link's preview image or an arbitrary object.

rules.rule: Callers of bulkDeleteLinks must pass links from a single workspace.
rules.why: totalLinks is decremented only on links[0].projectId, so mixed lists corrupt usage counts for the other workspaces.

rules.rule: Fetch user-supplied URLs only with safeFetch or safeFetchNode.
rules.why: Plain fetch can reach private or internal hosts (SSRF) from our servers.

rules.rule: Every withWorkspace route that reads or changes data declares requiredPermissions (and requiredPlan where gated).
rules.why: With the default [] any workspace member, and any scoped API key that reaches the route, passes.

rules.rule: Server actions built on authActionClient must check role/permission themselves (throwIfNoPermission) before changing workspace data.
rules.why: authActionClient only verifies workspace membership, so members of any role could run the action.

rules.rule: Stripe webhook routes read the raw body with req.text() and verify it with stripe.webhooks.constructEvent before any JSON parsing or handling.
rules.why: Signature verification fails on a re-serialised body and unverified events would let anyone forge sales or subscription changes.

rules.rule: Each defineJob is registered in lib/jobs/registry.ts under a key equal to its name and dispatched via job.dispatch; handlers return for permanent skips and throw for transient failures.
rules.why: loadJob throws on a name mismatch (500, retried), an unregistered job gets a 2xx and is dropped silently, and a 500 on a bad payload makes QStash retry forever (.agents/skills/jobs-define-job/SKILL.md).

rules.rule: Customer webhook signatures are HMAC-SHA256 hex over JSON.stringify(payload); keep the signed and sent body identical.
rules.why: Any change to serialization or payload shape invalidates every customer's signature check.

rules.rule: HubSpot components live in their type's directory under src/app, config files end in -hsmeta.json with a project-unique uid, and cards/settings use hubspot.fetch only for URLs listed in config.permittedUrls.fetch.
rules.why: HubSpot project upload rejects misplaced or duplicate-uid components and blocks unlisted fetch URLs (packages/hubspot-app/CLAUDE.md).

rules.rule: A link create, update or delete changes Prisma, the Redis link cache (linkCache) and Tinybird (recordLink) together; an update that changes the domain or key also evicts the old cache entry.
rules.why: Redirects are served from linkCache and analytics from Tinybird: a write that skips one serves a stale or deleted link, or drops it from analytics.
